review: I just wanted to track calories and macros. I'm not interested in my weight or being an athlete. I was simply trying to eat better in hopes of easing a chronic condition. Instead, I ended up obsessing over goals the app made for me, which I had little control over and weren't what I needed. I got stressed enough to stop using the app because it became counterproductive. cannot recommend.
App is great but the ads are way to invasive. Plays a video add every time you interact with the app. Ruins an otherwise good app.

I like many options on this free version of the app.I really like the barcode scan feature and the exercise trackers. I have been using the free version for about 3 weeks and getting used to how to use it with my food scale. However, recently the ADS have started popping up for 90 seconds and won't let me add my food when I open the app. It's kind of infuriating. The ads aren't even for health related items/services. They are mostly for stupid game apps.

Ads can't be exited after completion. I don't mind watching ads in exchange for getting the free version of a useful app like this. However, the (X) button that pops up in the top corner after the ad playback has finished does not actually allow you to exit the ad, leaving you stuck on the ad screen and forced to close and reopen the app. Gets very annoying and frustrating when you're forced to do that multiple times in the course of sitting down to log all your food and activity for the day.

I watched my partner use the app the drop 20-lbs (off 148). I jumped in and dropped 20-lbs since April 12 off my 184-lb body; 5 more to go. The app is easy enough. It gives me a sense of control over what and how much I chose to eat relative to my caloric budget against my exercise. I have recommended the app to several friends. I paid for a year to silence the ads and get full reports...worth every penny.

I was looking for a free calorie counting app as an alternative to MyFitnessPal and saw this recommended on Reddit. I love this app. Easy to use, was able to connect it to my Garmin watch, so much interesting data. Very happy with this, highly recommend.
